# chrome.storage

The storage areas of an extension (src/extensions/storage.odin; src/page/ext_api.odin). local and sync are written to the profile; session lives in memory until the browser exits or the extension reloads; managed is empty (no policy sets it). Values are JSON.

Gate: permission `storage`; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab, Content. Source: `api/ext_storage.widl`.
